fields.name: certification_tier
fields.description: Tiered certification level distinguishing full oral+written qualification from written-only qualification when oral exam is unavailable in the target language.
fields.sample_quote: An individual qualifies as a tier 1 certified medical language interpreter if the individual... passes an oral and written examination... If an oral examination under Subsection (1)(b) is not available in the language for which an individual applies for certification, the individual may qualify as a tier 2 certified medical language interpreter if the individual passes the written portion of an examination.

fields.name: certified_languages
fields.description: The specific language(s) for which the interpreter is certified, as specified on the certificate.
fields.sample_quote: A certificate described in Subsection (1) shall specify the language that the person is certified for.

fields.name: language_pairs_required
fields.description: Whether the interpreter must demonstrate competency between English and at least one other language.
fields.sample_quote: acts as a medical language interpreter between English and at least one other language

fields.name: exam_content_areas
fields.description: Specific subject-matter domains tested in the certification examination.
fields.sample_quote: tests: basic language fluency... basic medical terminology... basic cultural competency relating to medical care beliefs and practices... knowledge and understanding of the national standards of practice... a basic understanding of medical confidentiality requirements, including the confidentiality requirements of the federal Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

fields.name: national_standards_adherence_required
fields.description: Whether the applicant must sign a statement agreeing to abide by a recognized national standards of practice document.
fields.sample_quote: signs a statement agreeing to abide by the national standards of practice

fields.name: recognized_national_certification_bodies
fields.description: Named national organizations whose certification examinations are accepted by the state for credentialing purposes.
fields.sample_quote: the National Board of Certification for Medical Interpreters; or the Certification Commission for Healthcare Interpreters

fields.name: compensation_required_for_regulation
fields.description: Whether the regulatory definition of a medical interpreter is limited to persons performing services for compensation (i.e., volunteers are excluded).
fields.sample_quote: a person who, for compensation, performs verbal language interpretation services between a health care provider who speaks English and another person

fields.name: confidentiality_breach_as_unprofessional_conduct
fields.description: Whether willful or negligent disclosure of confidential patient information is explicitly enumerated as unprofessional conduct subject to discipline.
fields.sample_quote: willful or negligent betrayal or disclosure of confidential information about which the certified medical language interpreter becomes knowledgeable as a result of or incidental to the certified medical language interpreter's practice
